evidence.statement: The consolidated Phase 8.4 catalogue contains 429 diagnostic commands: 237 for the EMM and 192 for the head unit. 420 rows are DDT_ONLY.
evidence.residual_uncertainty: The count is derived from private DDT catalogues; the individual command list is not published.

evidence.statement: The master matrix classifies 8 rows as VEHICLE_READ_CONFIRMED and 1 row as VEHICLE_WRITE_CONFIRMED_HISTORICAL. These 9 rows correspond to 9 archived L1 measurement events: 8 reads and 1 historical write with read-back.
evidence.residual_uncertainty: The historical write is a past event, not a current write permission.

evidence.statement: The EMM has five archived read observations: identity record, part number, cornering parameters, cornering flag, and the all-configuration record. The all-configuration read returned 295 response-payload bytes: 2 bytes of positive-response header and 293 bytes of configuration data, decoded to 462 fields.
evidence.measurement_ref: Phase 8.4 reconciliation of the Phase 6.1-6.5 archives; raw files private.
evidence.residual_uncertainty: The 293 bytes are configuration data, not firmware. The cornering function was not tested.

evidence.statement: The head unit has three archived read observations: identity record, part number, and the 0x6C1C configuration byte before the historical write. One historical write changed 0x6C1C from 0x38 to 0x78 and read it back as 0x78.
evidence.software_scope: 11.346.3206684-8060; head-unit update history not fully established
evidence.measurement_ref: Phase 8.4 reconciliation of the archived head-unit logs; raw logs private.
evidence.residual_uncertainty: The write is historical; Android Auto projection was not functionally tested.

evidence.statement: All nine L1 measurement events have private archived raw records and SHA-256 references. The transfer manifest verifies the transferred set; no raw record is published.
evidence.residual_uncertainty: The private archive is the evidence; public claims are derived.

evidence.statement: The head unit is associated with the multimedia CAN on OBD pins 12/13, not the standard diagnostic pins 6/14. A standard OBD2 adapter does not automatically reach that bus; the physical access path is not confirmed on this vehicle.
evidence.residual_uncertainty: The pinout is a Renault family reference; no continuity or pin measurement was made on this vehicle.

evidence.statement: The EMM all-configuration response spans 43 ISO-TP frames and about 893 ms. The complete response is a configuration snapshot, not a firmware image and not a memory-read service.
evidence.residual_uncertainty: Frame count and duration are measurement context; they do not change the access rights.

evidence.statement: The head-unit update artifacts analysed so far are a kernel image and a root filesystem delta, not a complete flash image. No complete OBD2 firmware dump is documented.
evidence.residual_uncertainty: Artifact analysis does not prove device-wide impossibility of another access path.
